svg.title: Halgrave in section, south to north
svg.text: Halgrave in section, south to north
the same 150 blocks of depth as the plan, and the 44 blocks of height the brief fixes
A plan hides the two things map-brief.md says a box plan loses — the ward is a hole, and the tower is a climb. Every plane of the brief’s massing
table is drawn at the region-local layer map.json puts it at, which is tide_y plus the height above the tide.
+14 the upper ward, the tower foot
−0.15 the cistern’s floor · 0.0 THE STANDING TIDE · +0.4 the causeway top
← 3 named planes land on this one block layer
−2.3 the well’s silt bed · −1.5 the drowned ward’s floor
← 2 named planes land on this one block layer
The tower zone, measured, at the same scale
the long section the engine builds at the region z7 declares (41 × 48 × 125), cut at x = 19 — the slice with the most floor in it. The
dashed rectangle is the whole site’s height and depth, laid on it from the same base.
the whole site is 44 tall and 150 deep
and the plan gives it a box 9 deep
